reply.body:
Independent guarded review of exact head d9cb98eb39973acbacd0d8058700f7498ad03ac1 (delta b13008c...d9cb98eb), against the issue plan in #2275.

**Verdict: APPROVE.** No blocking finding remains.

Scope and evidence read:

- The change does exactly what the plan specifies and nothing more: `capacity-probe.mjs` now refuses only when `memoryPressureLevel === PRESSURE_CRITICAL` (4), both in the refusals list (line 250) and, consistently, in the CPU-only re-sample predicate (line 228). Warning (2) is still read, still reported on the reading, and still required to be readable — fail-closed is untouched: `admits` requires `failures.length === 0` and `memoryPressureLevel !== null`, so an unreadable pressure value still refuses.
- The other guards are provably unchanged and independently exercised at warning level: new tests show swap-outs refuse at level 2 and the free-memory floor refuses at level 2; level-4 refusal and level-2 admission are covered on both mac-host and mac-main fixtures, and the CPU re-sample path was re-pinned to level 4.
- `fleet_page.py`'s informational note fires only on an otherwise-clean admitting row (`not notes`), so a genuine refusal is never diluted — both shapes are tested. Docstring matches the code.
- The consciously-kept `PRESSURE_WORDS` 1/2 entries and the `|| memoryPressureLevel` fallback are documented dead-but-complete mapping; an out-of-enum value would now admit rather than refuse, but the sysctl's documented values are exactly 1/2/4 and the plan explicitly chose "refuse only on critical". Acceptable as designed.
- Grep confirms no stale consumer of the old `memory pressure is warning` refusal string remains outside the intentionally updated fixtures; dispatcher/seat-room changes are wording-only.
- Design doc amendment and `verified_on` stamp match the implementation; CI's "Docs, secrets, lint and the language suites" is green on this head.

Local focused runs (read-only, no dependency install): `capacity-probe.test.mjs` 38/38, `seat-room.test.mjs` 7/7, `control.test_fleet_page` 175/175 — all green. `dispatcher.test.mjs` shows 3 failures in this isolated checkout, all in PR-link rendering (`[owner/repo#n]` linkification), which depends on the optional mdast parser that is deliberately absent without `node_modules` (`markdown.mjs` degrades to plain text by design); unrelated to this delta, and CI is green on this exact head across every required check (`review-settled` exit 0 before submission).
